purpose: Apply a lighter Quiksilver ranking overlay after user feedback that field sizes were too small for major movement.

14U Girls.movementCap: small-field cap; winner +4, runner-up +2, top-team poor finish max -2

16U Girls.movementCap: small-field cap; new finalists enter mid/lower table with review flags

16U Boys.movementCap: large-field secondary signal; winner +10 max from low base, finalists +5 to +7

18U Girls.movementCap: medium-field cap; champion +6, runner-up/new team mid-table

18U Boys.movementCap: partial-score cap; top 10 mostly protected; last-place penalty limited
